messages.呼吸を溜めてから撃つほど火力が跳ね上がる、傲慢斬撃の広域E.G.Oで、侵蝕では味: A multi-target Pride Slash E.G.O whose damage soars the more Poise she builds before using it; its Corrosion skill benefits from killing allies.
messages.呼吸の置き換え強化: 攻撃前に呼吸と呼吸回数を得るが、呼吸が15以上なら呼吸の代: **Replacement bonuses from Poise**: Before attacking, she gains Poise and Poise Count, but at 15 or more Poise, Final Power rises instead of Poise, and at 5 or more Poise Count, Coin Power rises instead of Count (Final Power scales with the highest Resonance, and the Count side with half of it).
messages.クリティカル強化: Ⅱコインは、呼吸威力と呼吸回数の合計に応じてクリティカルダメ: **Critical bonus**: Coin Ⅱ gains Critical damage based on combined Poise Potency and Count, up to 20% at Threadspin Ⅲ and 40% at Ⅳ. It also grants Deep Inhale on hit.
messages.討伐時: 対象を倒すと次のターンに深い吸気を得る。深い吸気はクリティカル時に呼吸: **On kills**: Defeating a target grants Deep Inhale next turn. Deep Inhale spends Poise Potency on Critical Hits to add Critical damage.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 体力が最も低い対象を、味方を優先して攻撃する。味方を含むとダメージ: **Corrosion skill**: Attacks the target with the lowest HP, prioritizing allies. +30% damage if allies are included, and from Threadspin Ⅲ, killing an ally restores SP.
messages.パッシブ「息」: 使用の次のターン開始時にネブライザーβ1を得て、敵を倒せばその: **Passive — Breath**: At the start of the turn after use, she gains 1 Nebulizer β, plus 1 for each enemy defeated and 2 for each ally defeated (accumulates during battle, up to 5). At Combat Start on a turn with Pride Absolute Resonance, she and a random ally gain Poise and Poise Count.
messages.呼吸を溜めた状態で、複数の敵に向けて撃つ。2ターン目以降が目安と考えられる。: Fire it at multiple enemies once Poise has built up. Turn 2 or later is likely a good guideline.
messages.共鳴を多く作るほど、強化が最大まで乗りやすい。: The more Resonance you build, the more easily the bonuses reach their maximum.
messages.侵蝕スキルは呼吸が15未満のとき自分の体力を消耗して呼吸を補う。味方を倒す性質上: The Corrosion skill spends her own HP to make up Poise when it is below 15. Because it kills allies, handle it with care outside specific teams.
messages.必要資源は憤怒1・色欲1・傲慢5で、傲慢に偏る。: It requires 1 Wrath, 1 Lust, and 5 Pride, heavily skewed toward Pride.
messages.Ⅲ: 共鳴数による上限が6に、クリティカルダメージ増加と侵蝕スキルの呼吸付与が加: **Ⅲ**: The Resonance-based cap becomes 6, and the Critical damage increase and the Corrosion skill's Poise infliction are added.
messages.Ⅳ: 基本威力が上がり、回数による強化の上限が3になり、クリティカルダメージ増加: **Ⅳ**: Raises Base Power, raises the Count-based bonus cap to 3, and raises the Critical damage increase to up to 40%. The Corrosion skill gains an effect that returns resources.
messages.エドガー家 チーフバトラー: S1(色欲)・S2(傲慢)・S3(憤怒)が必要資源: **[Edgar Family Chief Butler](persona:0408)**: S1 (Lust), S2 (Pride), and S3 (Wrath) match the required affinities, and she has many skills that build Poise.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の刀: 色欲・傲慢・憤怒のスキルを持ち、呼吸を稼ぐスキルも多い。傲慢の資: **[Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415)**: Has Lust, Pride, and Wrath skills and many skills that earn Poise. She supplies Pride resources.
